name: hn-top
author: sparkleware
description: Daily digest of HackerNews top stories — dev / startup / AI conversation in one terminal screen. No API key required.
long_description_md:
## What it does

Fetches HackerNews' top stories via the public Firebase API and prints the top 10 with title, author, score, comment count, and link. Optional `${var}` substring filter narrows to a topic (e.g. `${var}="rust"` or `${var}="AI"`).

## Why

HN is high-signal but easy to spend an hour scrolling. This skill compresses the current top-of-page into 30 seconds of glance time.

## How it works

11 requests per run (1 for the ranked ID list, 10 for individual story metadata). Pure JSON / `jq` parsing. Falls back to the HN discussion URL when a story has no external link (Ask HN, etc.). Optional log to `memory/logs/hn-daily-<date>.md` builds a searchable archive.

No auth, no key, generous Firebase rate limits — daily schedule is well under any threshold.

skills.name: hn-daily
skills.description: Top 10 HackerNews stories with score + comments + author, plus optional title-substring filter.
